description: Turns raw survey results (scores + open-text comments) or any pile of qualitative feedback (reviews, support tickets, open-ended comments) into a scored, statistically-tested, thematically-coded synthesis with severity-ranked findings. Trigger when someone pastes raw survey data, a CSV of responses, or a pile of qualitative feedback and wants it turned into findings. Entry point 2 of the research loop (see research-loop); also runs standalone without a survey-architect-built survey.
